response.sql:
WITH equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_avgs AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average
  FROM equipment_avg
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipment_reference,
         ea.average_humidity,
         ra.all_equipment_average
  FROM equipment_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_avgs ra
  WHERE ea.average_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.average_humidity > ra.all_equipment_average
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS above_average_group_mean
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.equipment_reference,
       aa.average_humidity,
       aa.average_humidity - aa.all_equipment_average AS above_all_equipment_average,
       aa.average_humidity - gm.above_average_group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN group_mean gm
WHERE gm.above_average_group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST,
         aa.average_humidity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the unweighted mean of each equipment’s non-missing average humidity; equipment with no humidity readings has a missing average and is excluded from that reference mean. Equipment without readings is also excluded from the above-average group.
